mapper.sql: select r.id as registrationId,r.registration_no as registrationNo,r.transaction_id as transactionId, r.payment_status as paymentStatus,r.registration_status as registrationStatus,r.wechat_payment_amount as wechatPaymentAmount, case when r.owner_type=1 then r.owner_id when r.owner_type=2 then a.topic_id else null end as topicId, case when r.owner_type=1 and r.owner_id>0 then true when r.owner_type=2 and a.id is not null then true else false end as relationPresent from cms_registration r left join cms_activity a on r.owner_type=2 and a.id=r.owner_id where r.id=#{registrationId}
mapper.select: select id,biz_type as bizType,biz_id as bizId,idempotency_key as idempotencyKey,money_affecting as moneyAffecting,state from wx_payment_callback_outbox where idempotency_key=#{key} for update

select refund.id from refund_application refund join cms_registration r on refund.source_type='registration' and r.id=refund.source_id left join cms_activity a on r.owner_type=2 and a.id=r.owner_id where refund.status=1 and ((r.owner_type=1 and r.owner_id=#{topicId}) or (r.owner_type=2 and a.topic_id=#{topicId})) order by refund.id for update

select id,registration_no as registrationNo,parent_order_no as parentOrderNo,owner_type as ownerType,owner_id as ownerId, member_id as memberId,order_num as orderNum,payment_status as paymentStatus,registration_status as registrationStatus, verification_status as verificationStatus,payable_amount as payableAmount,wechat_payment_amount as wechatPaymentAmount, transaction_id as transactionId from cms_registration where owner_type=1 and owner_id=#{topicId} order by id for update

select l.fact_id as id,l.fact_hash as hash from cms_registration r join wx_payment_callback_inbox i on i.biz_type=1 and i.biz_id=r.id and i.event_type='SUCCESS' and i.state=2 and i.notify_hash=unhex(sha2(concat('PAY:',r.transaction_id,':SUCCESS'),256)) join wx_payment_callback_fact_link l on l.inbox_id=i.id and binary l.notify_hash=binary lower(hex(i.notify_hash)) join wx_verified_payment_fact pf on pf.id=l.fact_id and pf.fact_hash=l.fact_hash and pf.fact_kind='PAYMENT' and binary pf.business_out_trade_no=binary r.registration_no and binary pf.transaction_id=binary r.transaction_id and pf.amount_fen=r.wechat_payment_amount*100 where r.id=#{registrationId} for update

select id,settlement_id as settlementId,claim_id as claimId,registration_id as registrationId,origin_amount as originAmount from coop_settlement_detail where settlement_id=#{settlementId} order by id for update
mapper.update: update coop_settlement head join coop_settlement_cash_close c on c.id=#{cashCloseId} and c.topic_id=head.topic_id set head.cash_close_id=#{cashCloseId},head.cash_head_kind=#{receiverKind} where head.id=#{settlementId} and head.topic_id=#{topicId} and (head.cash_close_id is null or head.cash_close_id=#{cashCloseId}) and ((#{receiverKind}='MEMBER' and head.merchant_id>0 and head.payee_type<>'platform') or (#{receiverKind}='ACCOUNTING' and head.merchant_id is null and head.payee_type='platform' and head.line_type in ('PLATFORM','DEPOSIT_DEDUCTION')))
mapper.sql: and #{originalOrderCash}=cast(json_unquote(json_extract(payer.registration_snapshot,'$.wechatPaymentAmount')) as decimal(15,2)) and binary h.line_type=binary #{lineType} and binary h.cash_head_kind=binary #{receiverKind} and (h.merchant_id <=> #{receiverMemberId}) and ((h.line_type in ('MERCHANT_VERIFY','LEAD_FEE') and exists ( select 1 from coop_settlement_detail d join settlement_claim sc on sc.id=d.claim_id where d.settlement_id=h.id and d.claim_id=#{sourceClaimId} and d.registration_id=r.registration_id and d.origin_amount=#{originalAmount} and sc.fulfillment_type='REGISTRATION' and sc.fulfillment_id=r.registration_id and sc.commercial_context_type=h.commercial_context_type and sc.commercial_context_id=h.commercial_context_id and sc.beneficiary_role=h.beneficiary_role and sc.beneficiary_id=h.beneficiary_id and sc.service_unit=h.service_unit and sc.settlement_route='COOP_ORDER' and sc.source_contract_type=h.source_contract_type and sc.source_contract_id=h.source_contract_id)) or (h.line_type in ('PLATFORM','INITIATOR_GUARANTEE','INITIATOR_MARGIN') and #{sourceClaimId} is null and r.registration_id=payer.registration_id))
mapper.insert: and not exists (select 1 from cms_registration_payment_fact consumed where consumed.registration_id=payer.registration_id) and exists (select 1 from wx_payment_callback_inbox pi join wx_payment_callback_fact_link pl on pl.inbox_id=pi.id and binary pl.notify_hash=binary lower(hex(pi.notify_hash)) where pi.biz_type=1 and pi.biz_id=payer.registration_id and pi.event_type='SUCCESS' and pi.state=2 and pi.notify_hash=unhex(sha2(concat('PAY:',pf.transaction_id,':SUCCESS'),256)) and pl.fact_id=pf.id and pl.fact_hash=pf.fact_hash)

and exists (select 1 from cms_registration_payment_fact consumed where consumed.registration_id=payer.registration_id and binary consumed.registration_no=binary pf.business_out_trade_no and consumed.payment_fact_id=pf.id and binary consumed.payment_fact_hash=binary pf.fact_hash and binary consumed.transaction_id=binary pf.transaction_id)
mapper.select: select * from coop_settlement_original_component where cash_close_id=#{cashCloseId} and payer_registration_id=#{payerRegistrationId} order by settlement_id,source_registration_id for update
select * from coop_settlement_original_component where cash_close_id=#{cashCloseId} order by settlement_id,source_registration_id for update

select id,topic_id as topicId,merchant_id as merchantId,amount,status,line_type as lineType, coop_order_id as coopOrderId,share_mode as shareMode,share_rate as shareRate,fixed_fee as fixedFee from coop_settlement where topic_id=#{topicId} order by id for update

select change_balance from ums_member_balance_detail where member_id=#{memberId} and event_type=5 and event_id=#{settlementId} and change_type=1 and change_balance>0 and change_reason=concat('Coop结算打款 - 主题',#{topicId}) order by id for update

select id,refund_no as refundNo,source_type as sourceType,source_id as sourceId,status, refund_amount as refundAmount,paid_amount as paidAmount,payout_status as payoutStatus, payout_method as payoutMethod,payout_receipt_url as payoutReceiptUrl, payout_handler_id as payoutHandlerId,payout_handled_at as payoutHandledAt, payout_reviewer2_id as payoutReviewer2Id,payout_reviewed2_at as payoutReviewed2At from refund_application where id=#{refundId} and del_flag=0 for update
mapper.sql: select f.id as refundId,f.source_type as sourceType,f.source_id as sourceId, r.id as registrationId,r.owner_type as ownerType,r.owner_id as ownerId, case when r.owner_type=1 then r.owner_id when r.owner_type=2 then a.topic_id else null end as topicId, case when r.owner_type=1 and r.owner_id is not null then true when r.owner_type=2 and a.id is not null then true else false end as relationPresent from refund_application f left join cms_registration r on f.source_type='registration' and r.id=f.source_id left join cms_activity a on r.owner_type=2 and a.id=r.owner_id where f.id=#{refundId} and f.del_flag=0
mapper.select: select l.fact_id as id,l.fact_hash as hash from refund_application f join wx_payment_callback_inbox i on i.biz_type=2 and i.biz_id=f.id and i.event_type='SUCCESS' and i.notify_hash=unhex(sha2(concat('REFUND:',f.refund_no,':SUCCESS'),256)) join wx_payment_callback_fact_link l on l.inbox_id=i.id and binary l.notify_hash=binary lower(hex(i.notify_hash)) where f.id=#{refundId} and f.del_flag=0 and f.status=1 and f.payout_status=1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into coop_settlement_refund_receipt (cash_close_id,topic_id,refund_id,verified_fact_id,verified_fact_kind,verified_fact_hash,source_registration_id,payer_registration_id, currency,refund_amount,total_amount,cumulative_before,cumulative_after,reversed_amount,calculation_version,source_fingerprint) select #{cashCloseId},#{topicId},#{refundId},#{verifiedFactId},#{verifiedFactKind},#{verifiedFactHash},#{sourceRegistrationId},#{payerRegistrationId}, #{currency},#{refundAmount},#{totalAmount},#{cumulativeBefore},#{cumulativeAfter},#{reversedAmount},#{calculationVersion},#{sourceFingerprint} from refund_application f join coop_settlement_cash_close c on c.id=#{cashCloseId} and c.topic_id=#{topicId} join coop_settlement_cash_contribution r on r.cash_close_id=c.id and r.registration_id=f.source_id where f.id=#{refundId} and f.del_flag=0 and f.source_type='registration' and f.status=1 and ((#{verifiedFactKind}='WX' and f.payout_status=1 and exists ( select 1 from wx_payment_callback_inbox i join wx_payment_callback_fact_link l on l.inbox_id=i.id and binary l.notify_hash=binary lower(hex(i.notify_hash)) join wx_verified_payment_fact pf on pf.id=l.fact_id and pf.fact_hash=l.fact_hash where i.biz_type=2 and i.biz_id=f.id and i.event_type='SUCCESS' and i.notify_hash=unhex(sha2(concat('REFUND:',f.refund_no,':SUCCESS'),256)) and pf.id=#{verifiedFactId} and pf.fact_hash=#{verifiedFactHash} and pf.fact_kind='REFUND' and binary pf.merchant_event_no=binary f.refund_no and binary pf.business_out_trade_no=binary r.payer_order_no and pf.amount_fen=#{refundAmount}*100 and pf.total_fen=#{totalAmount}*100 and pf.currency=#{currency})) or (#{verifiedFactKind}='MANUAL' and f.payout_status=4 and f.payout_handler_id>0 and f.payout_reviewer2_id>0 and f.payout_handler_id<>f.payout_reviewer2_id and f.payout_receipt_url is not null and f.payout_handled_at is not null and f.payout_reviewed2_at is not null and #{verifiedFactId}=f.id)) and f.refund_amount=#{refundAmount} and f.source_id=#{sourceRegistrationId} and r.payer_registration_id=#{payerRegistrationId}
mapper.select: select * from coop_settlement_refund_receipt where refund_id=#{refundId} order by id for update
select * from coop_settlement_refund_receipt where cash_close_id=#{cashCloseId} and payer_registration_id=#{payerRegistrationId} order by id for update
select * from coop_settlement_original_adjustment where receipt_id=#{receiptId} order by id for update
select * from coop_settlement_original_adjustment where settlement_id=#{settlementId} order by id for update
